newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westgold takes 6.25 pct of St Barbara.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westgold takes 6.25 pct of St Barbara.

text.p: Western Australian miner Westgold Resources NL said on Monday it has acquired 13.1 million shares, or a 6.25 percent stake, in gold producer St Barbara Mines Ltd.
St Barbara produced 68,936 ounces of gold in the half year to December 31, 1996.
Westgold announced in December it had taken a 6.75 percent stake in gold producer Mount Edon Gold Mines (Aust) Ltd.
Westgold said it would consider a friendly takeover offer for Mount Edon.
However, Camelot Resources NL and Canada's Teck Corp announced a surprise A$158 million takeover bid for Mount Edon on January 22.
Mount Edon's managing director Tony Brennan has advised shareholders to take no action over the bid.
